title: Derived pullback is left adjoint to derived direct image for ringed spaces
statement: Let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal B)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and let $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ and $\Mod(\mathcal B)$ be the sheaf-of-module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $Lg^*E:=\mathcal O_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}E$ using [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and let $Rg_*$ be the right derived functor of $g_*$ [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Then $Lg^*:D(\mathcal B)\rightleftarrows D(\mathcal O_X):Rg_*$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is an adjoint pair, with natural bifunctorial bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(Lg^*E,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(E,Rg_*F)$.

proof.text: Write $\rho:g^{-1}\mathcal B\to\mathcal O_X$ for the ring morphism induced by the structure map in [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. The underived pullback of a sheaf of $\mathcal B$-modules is $\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}(-)$. Apply the inverse-image/direct-image module adjunction [lem-pc-module-inverse-image-adjunction] to $g^{-1}\mathcal B$-modules, followed by the change-of-rings adjunction [lem-pc-module-change-of-rings-adjunction] along $\rho$. Their composite gives natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}E,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(E,g_*F)$, so the displayed underived pullback is left adjoint to $g_*$. Here $g_*F$ has the $\mathcal B$-module structure through $g^\sharp$ and sections $V\mapsto F(g^{-1}V)$, as stated in [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]; the inverse-image module structure and the sheaf-module categories are supplied by [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Tags 008A and 008Y, tensor/change-of-rings and inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions for sheaves of modules

proof.text: The functor in the first step has the total left derived functor $Lg^*=\mathcal O_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}(-)$, computed on K-flat resolutions. Every complex $E$ of $\mathcal B$-modules has a K-flat resolution $P\to E$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Since $g^{-1}$ is exact, $g^{-1}P\to g^{-1}E$ is a quasi-isomorphism, and $g^{-1}P$ is K-flat over $g^{-1}\mathcal B$ by [lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation] applied to the morphism of ringed spaces $(g,\mathrm{id}):(X,g^{-1}\mathcal B)\to(Y,\mathcal B)$, whose termwise pullback is $g^{-1}P\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}\mathcal B=g^{-1}P$. Hence, by [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] along $\rho$, $Lg^*E\cong\mathcal O_X\otimes_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}P$, and a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes is sent to a quasi-isomorphism; this gives the required left-derived comparison maps. The direct image has the total right derived functor $Rg_*$ computed on K-injective resolutions [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]; the existence and resolution comparison data are supplied by [def-pur-kinjective-complex] and [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Therefore the generic derived-adjunction theorem [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived] applies to the underived adjunction of step 1. It yields an adjunction $Lg^*\dashv Rg_*$ and its derived counit induced by the underived counit.

proof.text: By the conclusion of [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived], the adjunction is represented by natural bifunctorial Hom bijections. Substituting the definitions of the two derived functors from the statement gives $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(Lg^*E,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(E,Rg_*F)$, natural in both $E$ and $F$.
